values.description: Original Armold-type 6-axis MKS NEMA17 concept. Assumed keepouts. NOT FOR FABRICATION.

assumptions: Only two MKS SERVO42D CAN MT motor/driver sets are ordered; six depicted units describe a future configuration.
Actual ordered motor length, shaft, rear driver/heatsink and connectors are not measured. All motor/driver boxes are replaceable assumptions.
Housing diameters changed from the initial 80/68 mm proposal to 90/104/78 mm for a readable concept and no implied tight fit around reference discs.
J5 to J6 offset increased from 72 to 140 mm after exact kernel interference found the roughly 81 mm rear MKS stack penetrating J5. This visibly lengthens the wrist.
Reference cycloidal ratios and disc diameters are not verified reductions or matched internals for this concept.
The display pose is not a collision-free workspace or fabrication approval. Wrist axes are deliberately offset, not a spherical wrist.
Native dimensions are editable; geometry placement and pose are regenerated from this file. Native joints use zero at the displayed pose.
org.robotarmlab.concept.reducer_reference: Faze4 mechanisms only; not copied whole-arm geometry or validated ratio.
